title: Billing settlement requests return HTTP 503
symptoms: A billing transaction remained SETTLEMENT_SENT for more than 24 hours. Settlement requests returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable. Processing retries were exhausted without a successful response. The billing application was healthy.
past_root_cause: An engineer confirmed that the settlement service was unavailable during that past incident.
check_reason: Check settlement-service errors and application health before exploring a recent application change.

title: Card authorization fails after an application release
symptoms: Card payment authorization returned HTTP 500 with a local NullPointerException. Failures began immediately after a billing application release. Calls did not reach the card provider.
past_root_cause: An engineer confirmed that a field-mapping error in the application release caused those authorization failures.
check_reason: Compare the first local exception with the application release time and changed fields.

title: Payment database lock makes balance updates slow
symptoms: Balance updates waited for a database lock and then timed out. Database lock-wait metrics increased. A long-running reconciliation transaction held the affected account rows.
past_root_cause: An engineer confirmed that a long reconciliation transaction held locks needed by the balance updates.
check_reason: Inspect database spans to find where the update waited and compare them with lock metrics.

title: Expired access token blocks refund requests
symptoms: Refund requests returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. The access token had expired. The refund provider remained available and accepted requests with a fresh token.
past_root_cause: An engineer confirmed that the token refresh job had stopped, leaving the refund client with an expired access token.
check_reason: Check the refund request and authentication response before assuming the provider is unavailable.

title: Receipt emails delayed by a growing queue
symptoms: Payments completed successfully but receipt emails arrived late. Notification queue depth and oldest-message age increased. Notification workers had stopped reading new messages.
past_root_cause: An engineer confirmed that stopped notification workers caused the email queue to grow.
check_reason: Check notification worker health and queue age while keeping completed payment status separate.
